metadata.name: Sonic Dancing
metadata.description: You get sonic dancing on your playback bar!

files.index.css: .player-controls .playback-progressbar::before { content: ''; width: 32px; height: 32px; bottom: calc(100% - 7px); right: 10px; position: absolute; image-rendering: pixelated; background-size: 32px 32px; background-image: url('https://media.tenor.com/pWqGD2PHY3kAAAAj/fortnite-dance-sonic.gif'); }
